For it, evil is supposed to be something contingent, although it is itself alone the evil.

But that evil which is supposed to be found in particular for the relation of difference and for the separation from the eternal can be determined in no other way than as being the opposite of that absolute separation.

But the opposite of separation is nothing but the being-one with the eternal, and this would have to be the evil, as we saw above that the being-one with the universe, that the universe lives and works in me, obedience to the eternal law of nature and of holy necessity, is the most terrible and most melancholy thing for the I.

Just as difference or evil is not correctly conceived, so too the reconstruction cannot be of a genuine kind, because the infinite is posited as originally ununited and incompatible with the finite, the ideelle, pure reason, with the reelle, with existence.
zh: 这样，正如本源的东西没有被真正认识为自然，绝对理性没有被真正认识为自在地存在着、而不是首先在无限进展中才生成着的东西，差别关系也同样没有按其真理被认识；因为这种关系被理解为自在，因此是不能被扬弃的。
对差别关系来说，灾祸应当是某种偶然的东西，可它自己恰恰单独就是灾祸。
但那种据说还要特别为差别关系、为与永恒者的分离而被找到的灾祸，只能被规定为那种绝对分离的对立面。
而与分离相对立的东西不是别的，正是与永恒者的合而为一，而这就应当是灾祸，正如我们上面看到的：与宇宙合而为一，宇宙在我之中生活和起作用，服从自然的永恒法则和神圣的必然性，对这个我来说是最可怖、最令人悲伤的事。
正如差别或灾祸没有被正确理解，重构也不可能具有真正的性质，因为无限者与有限者、观念物即纯粹理性与实在物即存在，被设定为本源地不统一的和不可统一的。

en: This reconstruction would have to reveal the essence of spirit and present it as: how in it, as free, nature reflects itself, which withdraws into itself and raises its original, unborrowed, real beauty into the ideelle or possibility and thus raises itself as spirit, – which moment, insofar as identity as originality is compared with totality, appears through this alone as movement and shattering of identity and as reconstruction, – and how the essence of nature, in the form of possibility or as spirit, enjoys itself as a living ideal in intuitable and active reality and as ethical nature has its actuality, in which the ethically infinite or the concept and the ethically finite or individuality are absolutely one.
zh: 这种重构必须揭示精神的本质，并把它描述成这样：自然如何作为自由的东西在精神之中反思自身，如何回返到自身之中，并把它本源的、非借来的、实在的美提升进观念物或可能性之中、从而把自身提升为精神，——而这个环节，就同一性作为本源性而与总体性相比较而言，仅由此才表现为同一性的运动和碎裂、表现为重构，——以及自然的本质如何以可能性的形式或作为精神，在可直观的、能动的实在性中作为活生生的观念的东西享受自身，并且作为伦理的自然具有自己的现实性，在其中伦理上无限的东西或概念与伦理上有限的东西或个体性绝对是一体的。

en: But since in this formalism the spirit is once and for all fixed as indifference, absolutely over against the different, no true reality of the ethical can take place, no being-one of its concept and its actuality.

The practically ideal, the concept of purpose posited by the pure will, is that pure indifference and emptiness, while the content is the particular of individuality or the empirical element of well-being, and both are incapable of being one in an ethical totality.

The absolute manifoldness of this empirical material, formally taken up into indifference or into the concept, yields a manifoldness of rights, just as the formal totality of these and their becoming real yield the constitution of right and the state.

According to the principle of the system, that the concept in this unmoved form of opposition is absolute, the juridical and the construction of the juridical as a state is something existing for itself and absolutely opposed to livingness and individuality.

It is not the living itself that at the same time posits itself universally in the law and becomes truly objective in the people, but rather the universal, fixed for itself, confronts it absolutely as a law, and individuality finds itself under absolute tyranny.
Right is to happen, but not as inner but as outer freedom of the individuals, which is a subsuming of these under the concept foreign to them.
Here the concept becomes the absolutely objective and the shape of an absolute thing, to be dependent on which is the annihilation of all freedom.
zh: 但既然在这种形式主义里，精神一旦被固定为无差别、绝对地与有差别的东西相对立，就不可能有伦理的东西的任何真正实在性，也不可能有它的概念与其现实性的合而为一。
实践上观念的东西，即由纯粹意志设定的目的概念，就是那种纯粹的无差别和空虚，而内容则是个体性的特殊东西或福祉的经验的东西，两者都不能在一个伦理的总体性中成为一体。
这种经验东西的绝对杂多，形式上被接纳进无差别或概念之中，就给出一种权利的杂多，正如这些权利的形式的总体性及其实在化给出权利宪制和国家。
按照体系的原则——概念在这种不可移易的对立形式中是绝对的——，权利的东西以及把权利的东西建构为一个国家，就是某种自为存在的东西，绝对与生命性和个体性相对立。
这并不是活生生的东西本身，即那种同时在法律中把自己设定为普遍的、并在民族中真正成为客观的东西，相反，那被固定为自为的普遍东西作为一种法律绝对地与这种权利的东西相对立，而个体性则处在绝对的专制之下。
权利应当实现，但不是作为诸个体的内在自由，而是作为他们的外在自由，这种外在自由就是把他们归摄到那对他们陌生的概念之下。
在这里，概念成了绝对客观的东西，成了一个绝对之物的形态，依赖于这个绝对之物就是一切自由的毁灭。

en: But as regards the other side, namely that the concept of purpose produced by the pure will, if anything more than formal could really be produced from it, is subjective and presents itself as the ethical life of individuals or as morality, here the content of the concept, the reality posited in ideal form as purpose and intention, is some empirically given [content], and only the empty form is the a priori.
But it is not the material part of the purpose, but its formal side, the pure will, that is what is mine; the I is itself the pure will.
But here there is just as little to be thought of a true ethical life, namely a true identity of the universal and the particular, of matter and form.
Because the emptiness of the pure will and of the universal is the truly a priori, the particular is something absolutely empirical.

What right and duty are in and for themselves – to give a determination of this would be contradictory; for the content at once sublates the pure will, duty for duty's sake, and makes duty into something material.
The emptiness of the pure feeling of duty and the content constantly get in each other's way.

And since morality, in order to be pure, may be posited in nothing other than the empty form of consciousness, that I know that I act in accordance with duty, an ethical life that is otherwise pure for itself must draw the content of its doing from its higher, truly ethical nature, and the addition of this consciousness, in which the moral is absolutely to consist, serves for nothing but to alloy and to defile it.

If in true ethical life subjectivity is sublated, then on the contrary through that moral consciousness the annihilation of subjectivity is known, and thereby subjectivity is itself held fast and saved in its annihilation, and virtue, in that it transforms itself into morality, [becomes] the necessary knowledge of its virtue, i.e. Pharisaism.
zh: 但就另一面而言，即：由纯粹意志生产出来的目的概念，如果真能从它那里生产出比形式的东西更多的东西，就是主观的，并且作为单个个人的伦理或作为道德而出现，——那么在这里，概念的内容，即作为目的和意图而被设定在观念形式中的实在性，就是某种经验地被给予的东西，而只有空洞的形式才是先验的东西。
但属于我的并不是目的的材料方面，而是它的形式方面，即纯粹意志；我这个我本身就是纯粹意志。
但在这里，同样谈不上一种真正的伦理，即普遍与特殊、材料与形式的真正同一性。
因为纯粹意志和普遍东西的空虚才是真正先验的东西，所以特殊东西就是绝对经验的东西。
自在自为的权利和义务是什么——对此给出一个规定，会是自相矛盾的；因为内容立刻就把纯粹意志、把为义务而尽的义务扬弃掉，并把义务弄成某种材料性的东西。
纯粹义务感的空虚和内容不断地互相挡道。
而且，既然道德为了纯粹只可以被设定在意识的那种空洞形式里，即我知道我是合乎义务地行动的，那么一种本来自为地纯粹的伦理，就必须从它更高的、真正伦理的本性中汲取它行动的内容，而这种意识的附加——道德恰恰应当存在于这种意识之中——除了把它掺假、把它弄脏之外，别无用处。
如果在真正的伦理中主观性已被扬弃，那么相反，通过那种道德的意识，主观性的消灭就被知道了，从而主观性在自己的消灭中本身反倒被坚持住、被拯救下来，而德性在转化为道德时，[就]成为对自己的德性的必然知识，也就是成为法利赛主义。

en: But if true ethical life is not presupposed, then it is open [to one], since morality consists in the form of raising all moral contingencies into the form of the concept and of procuring for the unethical a justification and a good conscience.

The duties and laws, since in the system, as shown above, they are an infinitely scattered manifoldness, each of equal absoluteness, make a choice necessary, which choice is absolutely the subjective, for the objective, the form of universality, is what is common to all.

Now no actual case of an action can be thought which would not have several sides, of which, while other duties are transgressed, others are obeyed, while other duties are obeyed, others are transgressed, – in which there are not sides that must count as duties; for every intuition of an actual case is infinitely determinable through the concept.

If one's own contingent, bad sense determines this choice, then it is something unethical which nevertheless justifies itself before itself through the consciousness of the side of the action from which it is a duty, and gives itself a good conscience.

But if the mind is otherwise honest enough in itself to want to act objectively, then the contingency of the duties stands over against it, because there are a multitude of them, and in the multitude the single one becomes something contingent, and it must fall into that sad indecision and into weakness, which consists in this, that for the individual only contingency is present and it can, nor may, create a necessity for itself out of itself.

But if it decides for any one of the many duties, then a decision has its possibility in the unconsciousness of the infinite multitude of duties, into which, as into infinite qualities, the actual case of acting can be resolved just as every actual thing, and must be resolved out of duty.
The knowledge of these qualities, which the concepts of duty furnish, is, because they are empirically infinite, impossible, and yet is absolutely demanded as a duty.

Since in this way unconsciousness of the whole scope of the considerations in acting and lack of the required insight become absolutely necessary, the consciousness of this contingency of acting must be present, which is the same as the consciousness of immorality.

Genuine ethical life is therefore defiled by the addition of this kind of consciousness of its dutifulness and, through this morality, made unethical if possible, while to the unethical itself, through the consciousness of some duty, which according to the concept of the matter cannot be lacking in it, the justification of the unethical is given, but to striving, honest minds the consciousness of necessary unethicalness is given, namely ethical life in general under the shape of the contingency of insight, which it absolutely is not to have.

And therefore this representation of ethical life as morality, since through it the truly ethical is transformed into baseness, strength into weakness, while baseness is justified as morality, has been able so easily to pass over from philosophy as science into the general public and to make itself so popular.
zh: 但如果不预设真正的伦理，那就随人自便了，因为道德就在于这种形式：把一切道德上的偶然性提升到概念的形式中去，并为不伦理的东西弄到一种辩护和一种好良心。
种种义务和法律，既然在体系中如上所示是无限地四散开来的杂多，每一个都具有同样的绝对性，就使一种选择成为必然，而这种选择绝对是主观的东西，因为客观的东西、即普遍性的形式，是一切所共有的东西。
现在，不可能设想出任何一个现实的行动情形，它没有好几个方面——在这些方面，别的义务被违反时，另一些义务被遵守，另一些义务被遵守时，另一些义务被违反，——在其中没有必须被看作义务的方面；因为对一个现实情形的每一种直观，都可以通过概念无限地被规定。
如果是自己那种偶然的、恶劣的心思决定了这种选择，那它就是一种不伦理的东西，但它通过意识到行动的那个使它成为义务的方面，在自己面前为自己辩护，并给自己一个好良心。
但如果心灵本来足够诚实，想要客观地行动，那么义务的偶然性就与它相对立，因为义务有一大堆，而在这一大堆里，单个的义务就成了某种偶然的东西，于是它必然陷入那种可悲的犹豫不决和软弱之中，这种犹豫不决和软弱就在于：对个体来说只有偶然性存在，而它不能、也不可以从自身中为自己造出一种必然性。
但如果它决定选择许多义务中的某一个，那么一个决定的可能性就在于对义务的无限多寡的无意识，而现实的行动情形，正如每一个现实的东西一样，可以被分解为这些义务、即分解为无限多的质，并且出于义务也必须被这样分解。
对这些性质的知——义务概念所提供的正是这些性质——，因为它们在经验上是无限的，所以是不可能的，但作为义务却又被绝对地要求。
由于这样一来，对行动中全部考虑范围的无意识以及缺乏所要求的洞见就绝对地成为必然的，所以对这种行动偶然性的意识必然存在，而这等于不道德的意识。
所以，真正的伦理通过附加这种对自己合乎义务的意识而被弄脏，并通过这种道德而尽可能地变得不伦理，而不伦理的东西本身则通过随便哪一种义务的意识——按照事情的概念，这种意识不可能在它那里缺失——得到对不伦理的东西的辩护，但努力着的、诚实的心灵得到的却是对必然的不伦理的意识，也就是伦理本身处在洞见的偶然性这一形态之下，而这是它绝对不应当有的。
因此，这种把伦理当作道德的表象，既然通过它，真正伦理的东西被变成卑鄙，力量被变成软弱，而卑鄙却被当作道德来辩护，就如此容易从作为科学的哲学转入普通公众之中，并且如此受人欢迎。

en: The reality of the ideal, which we have considered up to now, was the content that the empty ideal element of the pure will received.

Besides this still inner side, there remains over the outer side of the concept of purpose, which — as we have seen how — now has a content: namely the side of formal idealism, according to which the practical supersensuousness so far presents itself at the same time as appearance.

This appearance is the whole of the action, partly intuited in the empirical form, drawn apart as change and effects in time, but partly the reality of the supersensuous concept of purpose is also to be a consequential continuation of the action in the supersensuous world itself, the principle of a series of spiritual effects — which latter expresses nothing but the empiricism and temporality carried into the spiritual itself, whereby the spiritual becomes a kingdom of spirits.

For in the truly spiritual and in the idea there is no series nor consequence; only when the idea has first been made finite by being set over against a sensible sphere and as spiritual, and then this spiritual sphere itself is again qualitatively shattered into an infinite multitude of spiritual atoms, subjectivities as citizens of a thing that is called the kingdom of spirits, can there be any talk of spiritual consequences.

The speculative element that lies in this, that the idea — which, moreover, itself occurs only empirically as the purpose of an action and as something affected by subjectivity — is the eternal element of that which appears in the world of sense as a series of changes, is thus, to boot, lost entirely through the form of an absolute spiritual sphere in which there are consequences, and through its opposition, which it has to a sensible world still existing outside it, if that supersensuous element were not already itself sensible enough.

The construction of the ethical idea — here, of the purpose of reason, which is to be realized in the moral world order — instead of keeping itself within the philosophical standpoint, passes over into empirical-historical considerations, and the eternity of the ethical idea into an empirically infinite progress.

Of the speculative there is nothing to be seen but the idea of faith, through which the identity of the subjective and the objective, of the ideal and the real, is posited — an idea, however, that remains something absolutely formal; it serves only to leap over from the empty pure will to the empirical.

What remains lying at the ground is the absolute finitude of a subject and of an action, and over against it a sensible world devoid of reason and to be annihilated, and then a supersensuous world scattered apart into the infinity of intellectual singularities and absolutely opposed to the sensible one, whose true and content-rich identity, since all these finitudes are absolute, is a beyond and has nowhere come forth in all that we have so far considered of ethical life.

And that in this way — since according to the system the I as the absolute confesses itself in the theoretical to be affected by a not-I, but in the practical pretends to dissolve this temporality — the reason-idea of the identity of the subjective and the objective is something purely formal for science and merely pre-given, could be proved only by showing of that practical side how this idea is in it not constructed but throughout absent, and how there rules not a sound understanding but one that has departed from all health, hardened in the superstition of reflection and stuck in formal science, which it calls its deduction — an understanding whose subordinate sphere, in which speculation is to be found, namely the idea of the transcendental imagination, we have illuminated in the case of the Kantian philosophy, and which we have also had to follow in what are for it ideals, moral world order, purpose of reason, in its practical realities, in order to show the absence of the idea in them themselves.
zh: 我们迄今所考察的观念东西的实在性，就是纯粹意志那个空洞的观念物所获得的内容。
除了这个仍然是内在的方面之外，还剩下目的概念的外在方面——我们已经看到它是怎样获得内容的——，也就是形式观念论的方面：按照这个方面，迄今为止的实践的超感性同时把自己呈现为现象。
这种现象就是行动的整体：一部分是在经验的形式中被直观，作为时间中的变化和效果而被拉开；另一部分则是，超感性的目的概念的实在性也应当是行动在超感性世界本身之中的一种后果丰富的继续，是一系列精神效果的原则——后一种说法所表达的，无非是被带进精神东西本身之中的经验和时间性，由此精神东西就成为一个精神王国。
因为在真正精神的东西里、在观念里，既没有系列也没有后果；只有当观念首先由于被设定为与一个感性领域相对立、并被设定为精神的而有限化，然后这个精神领域本身又重新在质上被分裂为无限多的精神原子、即作为叫作精神王国的那样一个东西的公民的主体性时，才谈得上精神的后果。
思辨的东西——它在于：观念（它本身毕竟只是经验地作为行动的目的、并作为被主体性触动的东西而出现）是那个在感性世界里作为一系列变化而显现的东西的永恒东西——于是也就更加多余地、彻底地消失在一种绝对的精神领域的形式之中（这种领域里有各种后果），并消失在它与一个还在它之外现成存在的感性世界的对立之中，如果那个超感性的东西本身还不已经足够感性的话。
伦理的观念——在这里就是那个应当在道德世界秩序中实现出来的理性目的——的建构，不是保持在哲学立场之中，而是转入经验—历史的考虑，而伦理的观念的永恒性则转入一种经验上无限的进展。
在思辨的东西那里，除了信仰的观念之外什么也看不到：通过这种信仰，主观东西与客观东西的同一性、观念东西与实在东西的同一性被设定了——但这个观念始终是某种绝对形式的东西；它只是用来从空洞的纯粹意志跳到经验的东西上去。
留作根据的东西，是一个主体和一种行动的绝对有限性，以及在它对面一个有待消灭的、无理性的感性世界，然后是一个被抛散进智性个别东西的无限性之中、并与感性世界绝对对立的超感性世界，而这个超感性世界真正的、内容丰富的同一性，既然所有这些有限性都是绝对的，就是一个彼岸，并且在我们迄今就伦理所考察的一切东西中哪儿也没有出现过。

而这一点——按照体系，我在理论东西里作为绝对者承认自己受到一个非我的触动，但在实践东西里却佯称要化解这种时间性，所以主观东西与客观东西的同一性这个理性观念对科学来说就是某种纯然形式的东西、只是被预先给予的东西——只有这样才可能得到证明：即指出，在那个实践东西上，这个观念在其中并没有被建构起来，而是通篇都不在场，并且在那里起统治作用的不是一个健全的知性，而是一个背离了一切健全、硬化在反思迷信中、并陷在他称之为自己的演绎的那种形式科学里的知性——对于这个知性，我们在康德哲学那里照亮了其中可以找到思辨的那个从属领域，即先验想象力的观念，并且我们也不得不跟着它走进对它来说叫作理想、道德世界秩序、理性目的的那些东西，走进它的实践实在性，为的是指明观念在它们本身那里的不在场。

en: After in this way, through the totality of the philosophies considered, the dogmatism of being has been recast into the dogmatism of thinking, the metaphysics of objectivity into the metaphysics of subjectivity, and thus the old dogmatism and metaphysics of reflection has through this whole revolution of philosophy at first only put on the colour of the inner or of the new and fashionable culture — the soul as thing [transformed] into I, as practical reason into the absoluteness of personality and of the singularity of the subject, — the world, however, as thing into the system of appearances or of affections of the subject and of believed actualities, — the absolute, however, as an object and absolute object of reason into an absolute beyond of rational cognition — and this metaphysics of subjectivity, while other shapes of it do not count even in this sphere itself, has run through the complete cycle of its forms in the Kantian, Jacobian and Fichtean philosophy, and has thus completely presented what is to be reckoned on the side of culture, namely the absolutizing of the individual dimensions of totality and the working out of each of them into a system, and has thereby finished the forming — so is there hereby immediately posited the external possibility that true philosophy, arising out of this culture and annihilating the absoluteness of its finitudes, at the same time presents itself, with its whole wealth subjected to totality, as a completed appearance.

For just as the completion of fine art is conditioned by the completion of mechanical skill, so too is the rich appearance of philosophy conditioned by the completeness of culture, and this completeness has been run through.
zh: 这样，通过所考察的这些哲学的总体性，存在的独断论被重新熔铸为思维的独断论，客体性的形而上学被重新熔铸为主体性的形而上学，而旧的独断论和反思形而上学通过哲学的这一整场革命，起初只是披上了内在东西的颜色、或新的时髦教养的颜色——灵魂作为物变成了我，作为实践理性变成了人格与主体个别性的绝对性，——世界作为物则变成了现象的系统、或主体诸触动与所信仰的现实性的系统，——而绝对者作为理性的一个对象和绝对客体，则变成了理性认识的绝对彼岸——；而主体性的这种形而上学——它的其他形态即使在这个领域本身里也不算数——在康德、雅可比和费希特哲学里走完了它各种形式的完整循环，从而把该算在教养一边的东西，即把总体性各个单独维度设定为绝对、并把其中每一个都加工成体系，完整地展示了出来，并由此结束了教养；因此，这里就直接设定了外在的可能性：真正的哲学从这种教养中产生出来、并消灭这种教养那些有限性的绝对性，带着它全部服从于总体性的丰富内容，同时把自己呈现为完成了的现象。
因为正如美的艺术的完成以机械技能的完成为条件，哲学的丰富现象也以教养的完整性为条件，而这种完整性已经走完了。

en: But the immediate connection of these philosophical formations with philosophy — a connection of which the Jacobian philosophy is most lacking — and their positive, true, but subordinate place in it, is clear from what has emerged on the occasion of these philosophies about infinity, which is the principle made into the absolute for them and thereby afflicted with the opposition to finitude; in that in them thinking is cognized as infinity and the negative side of the absolute — which is the pure annihilation of the opposition or of finitude, but at the same time also the source of the eternal movement, or of the finitude that is infinite, i.e. that eternally annihilates itself, out of which nothing and pure night of infinity the truth lifts itself up as out of the secret abyss that is its birthplace.
zh: 但是，这些哲学形成物与哲学的直接联系——雅可比哲学最缺少的就是这样一种联系——，以及它们在哲学中那种肯定的、真正的、但却是从属的位置，是从这一点得到照亮的：借这些哲学之机关于无限性所得出的东西，——这种无限性是它们弄成绝对者、并因此带有对有限性的对立的原则——；因为在它们那里，思维被认作无限性、被认作绝对者的否定方面——这个否定方面是对对立或有限性的纯粹消灭，但同时也是永恒运动、或者说那种无限的、即永恒消灭自身的有限性的源泉，真理就是从这种无限性的无和纯粹黑夜中、像从它那个作为出生地的隐秘深渊中一样升起来的。

en: Since for cognition this negative meaning of the absolute, or infinity, is conditioned by the positive idea that being is absolutely not outside the infinite — I, thinking — but that both are one, so of these philosophies of reflection nothing was to be kept off but this: that infinity, the I, should not again — as happened in them — instead of at once leaping over into the positive of the absolute idea, fix itself at this point and become subjectivity, whereby it again fell down into the old opposition and into the whole finitude of reflection, which it had itself previously annihilated; but on the other hand, infinity and thinking — which fixes itself as I and subject and thereby keeps the object or the finite over against itself, and so stands on the same level with it from this side — is, on the other side, because its inner character is negation, indifference, closer to the absolute than the finite is, and so too is the philosophy of infinity closer to the philosophy of the absolute than that of the finite.
zh: 既然对认识来说，绝对者的这种否定意义、或者说无限性，是由那个肯定的观念制约的——即存在绝对不在无限者、我、思维之外，而是两者是一——，那么对这些反思哲学来说，要防的事不是别的，就是：无限性、我不要像在它们那里发生的那样，不是直接跳进绝对观念的肯定东西里去，而是在这个点上把自己固定下来、变成主体性，从而又落回它自己此前所消灭的旧对立和反思的全部有限性之中；而另一部分则是，无限性和思维——它把自己固定为我、固定为主体，并因此把客体或有限东西这样保持在自己对面，所以从这一面看与它处在同一等级上——，在另一面，由于它的内在性格是否定、是无差别，就比有限东西更接近绝对者，同样，无限性的哲学也比有限东西的哲学更接近绝对者的哲学。

en: But the pure concept, or infinity as the abyss of nothing, in which all being sinks, must designate the infinite pain — which previously was only historical in culture and was the feeling on which the religion of the new time rests — the feeling: God himself is dead (what was, as it were, only empirically expressed with Pascal's words: "la nature est telle qu'elle marque partout un Dien perdu et dans l'homme et hors de l'homme"224) ) — purely as a moment, but also as nothing more than a moment of the highest idea, and thereby give a philosophical existence to what was perhaps also either a moral precept of a sacrifice of the empirical being or the concept of formal abstraction, and thus restore to philosophy the idea of absolute freedom and with it the absolute suffering, or the speculative Good Friday that otherwise was historical, and restore it itself in the whole truth and hardness of its godlessness, out of which hardness alone — because the serene, more groundless and more singular element of the dogmatic philosophies as well as of the natural religions must disappear — the highest totality in its whole seriousness and out of its deepest ground can and must rise again, at once all-encompassing and in the most serene freedom of its shape.
zh: 但纯粹概念、或者说作为无之深渊的无限性——一切存在都沉没在这个深渊里——，必须把那种无限的痛苦——它此前只是在教养中才是历史性的，并且是作为新时代的宗教所依据的那种情感——，即：上帝本身已经死了（这一点用帕斯卡的话来说，可以说是只被经验地说了出来：“la nature est telle qu'elle marque partout un Dien perdu et dans l'homme et hors de l'homme”224)）——，纯粹作为环节、但也不作为比最高观念的环节更多的东西来标示，并由此给那种或许是牺牲经验本质的道德规定、或许是形式抽象的概念的东西一种哲学的存在，从而把绝对自由的观念、并因此把绝对的痛苦、或者说把那个在别的情况下只是历史性的思辨的受难日重新还给哲学，并且把它本身在它无神性的全部真理和严酷中重新恢复起来，而唯有从这种严酷中——因为独断论哲学以及自然宗教中那些明朗的、更无根据的和更个别的东西必须消失——，最高的总体性才能也必须在它全部的严肃中、从它最深的根据中，同时既无所不包、又处在它形态最明朗的自由中，重新复活。
